mathematical_state.global_local_gain: Remains fully closed at its original v0.49 scope.
mathematical_state.scope: Fourteen denominator family fields hold together on the selected hub. The small-prime field is proved. The split middle range and the entire inert row B hold with the free row constant chosen at least 122. Inert rows C and D are covered under the local or aggregate conditions in the guide. The remaining C/D estimates keep the family conclusion open.

new_original_endpoints: G82C5 gives the guarded split middle-range StarAD inequality at all good points by a single augmented determinant.
L82K5 gives the cyclotomic lifting test LiftK, including residue characteristic two.
T82K6 gives the cyclotomic invariant and TBK tests at their specified exponents for every admitted level.
G82F4 constructs the table for StarF and gives the full Concl.two field on the original common hub.
I82W5 supplies JointParametersHubConditions for the actual inert Frobenius words.
R82W4 gives both cut-vector lifts at rrPar. I82B4–I82B5 construct the actual target decomposition for the marked row B words.
H82A1–H82A3 show finiteness and functoriality of the source arc classes and reduce the row B estimate to one integral cut-vector congruence, proved in B82R3.
A82N1–A82N5 determine the integral numerator forms for every sign pattern. J82F1–J82F3 identify the physical and constant frames through all the primitive levels at a cost of sigma.
D82P1–D82P3 detect the integral Wach lattice from primitive levels; P82U3 proves the filtered lift for down-before-up arcs. K82P1–K82P4 give both polynomial operators and their valuations at one.
B82R3 proves the native cut-vector congruence, the full finite-class lift and the whole guarded inert row B for the common choice C2 >= 122.
I82B1 and N82I1–N82I2 give the stated local inert row subranges. G82I2 proves the global inert comparison and applies it at the covered indices.
mixedrange: The three-term allowance on words of every shape.
ccsum: An aggregate sufficient condition at such a prime.

denominator_family.hypotheses: Hypotheses_2, TwGood, FactsF with C >= 0 and C2 >= 1, for late family members satisfying TwistedPlaces.ShaFinOdd (all primes, including 2, for 0 < e < t in this pinned definition). The independent bb estimate does not need C >= 0.
denominator_family.scope_of_bb: All guarded split and inert primes, including nonempty split columns on the selected twist. The original coarse constant is 120 and the resulting error constant is 7200.
denominator_family.scope_of_typ: Both original type primes and all lifts, with the paired-character field of the native FactsF assumption.
denominator_family.scope_of_large: CongBound_at holds for each sufficiently late member satisfying Facts on every localization passing its original large-prime guards and every admissible family, point and complement. The coefficient enlargement tests apply to the actual cut generators and descend. This gives Concl.large simultaneously with the preceding eleven fields.
denominator_family.scope_of_ram: For the original twisted indices at p=q,d and their good points, the integral rank estimate at 160 and the complete character estimate on the same local data yield the all-row inequality. The coefficient 2080 and nonnegative polynomial 181 f²t²(r+t) log b suffice. J78H2 gives Concl.ram with the same family constant as J80H2.

middle_range_progress.split_global: G82C5 proves the entire guarded split branch. It uses one augmented module for all the columns.
middle_range_progress.inert_global: G82I1–G82I2 give the all-row implication, including nonunit root differences and the available aggregate allowance.
middle_range_progress.inert_words: I82W5 gives the word predicates on the same selected representation. I82B1 and N82I1–2 prove placewise length bounds in specified subranges.
middle_range_progress.remaining: Only inert C/D indices outside the proved local and summed ranges remain for the middle field. The exact place-summed alternative is in G82I2.
middle_range_progress.inert_rows_C_D: Every nonthick place, every mixed place with p^2 g <= (8/9) h_B, and every mixed place of any fixed polynomial prime size eventually. All guarded row D indices with Frobenius different from complex conjugation are covered. For Frobenius equal to complex conjugation, C82S2 gives an aggregate bound, including de2 h_B <= 162 p F_min. See N82I2 and M82R2–3 for further exact tests.
middle_range_progress.inert_row_B: All guarded indices and good points with C2 >= 122, chosen before the common family cutoff (B82R3).

denominator_family.scope_of_two: At all primes dividing QS and at 3, including 2, the same qualifying family has a table of zero place lengths with non-place entry midF. At the enlarged common constant DFD14 is applied at a fresh cutoff before the member or hub is selected.
